modeling_decisions: Concept dome mass, high shoulders and angular rind retained. Exclude excessive photo-like pebble microdetail and arbitrary blocks at every face. Author one closed uneven radial mass with purposeful large blocky lobes and limited embedded angular surface outcrops, quieter upper planes and stronger side fractures; varied smaller rubble at contact skirt. No concave crater, snow, smoke, glow, exact photographed outline or surrounding terrain.
